notes.subject: דוה
notes.rationale: 'menstrual/unclean thing' — KJV/BSB 'menstruous cloth', JPS softens to 'one unclean', YLT 'a sickening thing'

notes.subject: אפדת
notes.rationale: rare word from the ephod's plating: 'plating of metal' (ASV) vs 'rich ornament' (Geneva)

notes.subject: צפוי / אפדת / מסכת
notes.rationale: three different metal-covering words (overlay, plated casting, poured image) collapsed into one idea by most versions

notes.subject: to the idol
notes.rationale: the verse ends with 'Get thee hence' spoken directly to the discarded image

translation: Aw na ⟨את⟩ aw ka warigwɛ ɲɛkɛrɛnbaw ka ɲɛbɔli ni ⟨את⟩ aw ka sanu sɛgɛlɛnbaw ka sinki-ɲɛbɔli kɛ jugu ye; aw bɛ u tu i n'a fɔ muso ka jɔli-kɛlɛn bali-fɛn; ko: “Bɔ yan!” aw na fɔ a ye.
